visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Sieve Instead of Trial Division
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every number is divided by every smaller number to test whether it is prime. Replace the nested loops with a sieve. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Trial division does about n squared divisions. The sieve crosses out multiples once and needs only about n log log n steps, which is why it is the standard way to list all primes up to a limit.
